narrative.text: Copyright notice for the System Package Data Exchange (SPDX) Specification Version 3.0 (2010–2024, The Linux Foundation and its Contributors, including SPDX Model contributions from OMG and its Contributors).

Licensing terms for the specification under the Community Specification License 1.0 (Community-Spec-1.0), with pre-existing uncontributed portions provided under the Creative Commons Attribution License 3.0 Unported (CC-BY-3.0).
Trademark notice stating that SPDX is a registered trademark of The Linux Foundation.

Trademark compliance condition for software claiming conformance to the specification, followed by the full Table of Contents covering the Preface, Sections 1–18 (Scope, References, Symbols, Terms, Conformance, Model and serializations, Additional information, Core, Software, Security, Licensing, SimpleLicensing, ExpandedLicensing, Dataset, AI, Build, Lite, and Extension), and Annexes A–F.
Continuation of the Table of Contents listing Annex F, Annex G (Community Specification License 1.0), and Annex H (Creative Commons Attribution License 3.0 Unported).

Preface introducing the Object Management Group (OMG), founded in 1989 as an open-membership standards consortium whose specifications implement Model Driven Architecture (MDA), including UML, CORBA, and CWM.
Overview of OMG specification availability, headquarters contact details in Milford, Massachusetts, ISO standard availability, and OMG's continuous review and issue reporting procedure.

Section 1 (Scope): Defines SPDX as an open standard data model and set of serialization formats for communicating bill of materials (BOM) metadata across software composition (Packages, Files, Snippets), builds, AI models, datasets, identities, provenance, integrity, licensing, security vulnerabilities, element relationships, lifecycle, and annotations.
Section 2 (References) heading and subsection number 2.1 introducing the specification's reference clauses.

Section 2.1 (Normative References): Lists the normative standards and specifications referenced by SPDX 3.0, including CPE 2.2/2.3, CVSS v3.0/v3.1/v4.0, EPSS, SSVC, IEEE POSIX.1-2017, W3C RDF, IETF RFCs for hash digests (MD2, MD4, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-2, BLAKE2), ZLIB, MIME media types, URIs, ABNF, JSON, and CoSWID, SemVer 2.0.0, SLSA Provenance v0.2, SWHID, the SPDX RDF Ontology and License List, and CISA SBOM types.

Section 2.2 (Non-normative References): Lists 11 informative references covering the CISQ 3T-SBOM project, USENIX and congressional testimony on SBOMs, MITRE software supply chain publications, NTIA multistakeholder SBOM documents, OSI Approved Licenses, prior SPDX specification versions 1.0–2.3, and the May 2021 US Executive Order 14028 on cybersecurity.

Section 3 (Symbols): Defines 31 abbreviations and acronyms used throughout the specification, from 3T-SBOM, ABNF, AI, and BOM through CVSS, EPSS, JSON-LD, KEV, OWL, PURL, RDF, SBOM, SHACL, SPDX, SSVC, SWHID, and VEX.

Section 4 (Terms and definitions): Cites the ISO Online Browsing Platform and IEC Electropedia terminological databases and defines the term 'profile' as a targeted scope of SPDX usage identifying the namespaces, classes, properties, and custom constraints for a specific use case.
Section 5 (Conformance) heading and subsection number 5.1 introducing the conformance requirements.

Section 5.1 (Alternate notation for some conformance requirements): Explains how property cardinality assertions are expressed using `minCount` (minimum 0) and `maxCount` (unbounded `*`), alongside `0..1`, `0..*`, `1..1`, and `1..*` range notations.

Section 5.2 (Introduction to Profiles): Lists the nine SPDX compliance points (Core, Software, Security, Licensing, Dataset, AI, Build, Lite, and Extension Profiles), specifying that the Core Profile is mandatory and all others are optional.

Section 5.3 (Core Profile compliance point): Specifies the mandatory Core Profile providing foundational classes, properties, and vocabularies across all SPDX profiles, requiring conforming software to import and export documents in at least one defined SPDX serialization format.

Section 5.4 (Software Profile compliance point): Specifies conformance requirements for the Software Profile covering classes, properties, and vocabularies for software artifacts, which together with the Core Profile forms the baseline for SBOM interchange without requiring support for other optional profiles.

Section 5.5 (Security Profile compliance point): Specifies conformance requirements for exchanging software vulnerability, severity, exploitability, and remediation information under the Security Profile without entailing support for other optional profiles.

Section 5.6 (Licensing Profile compliance point): Specifies conformance requirements for exchanging software licensing and intellectual property metadata—encompassing both the SimpleLicensing and ExpandedLicensing profiles, SPDX License Expressions, and the SPDX License List—independently of other optional profiles.

Section 5.7 (Dataset Profile compliance point): Specifies conformance requirements for exchanging dataset metadata, provenance, structure, licensing, and statistical characteristics for AI systems or other applications under the Dataset Profile.

Section 5.8 (AI Profile compliance point): Specifies conformance requirements for exchanging inventories of AI/ML models, frameworks, libraries, versions, licenses, and ethical and security considerations under the AI Profile.

Section 5.9 (Build Profile compliance point): Specifies conformance requirements for capturing and exchanging software build inputs, outputs, instructions, environments, actors, and evidence under the Build Profile.

Section 5.10 (Lite Profile compliance point): Specifies conformance requirements for the Lite Profile, which captures the minimum SBOM, package, licensing, and relationship information needed for software supply chain license compliance.

Section 5.11 (Extension Profile compliance point): Specifies conformance requirements for the Extension Profile, enabling profile-based element characterization extensions, community-specific metadata, and structured solutions for coverage gaps via subclasses of the abstract `Extension` class.

Section 5.12 (Trademark Compliance): Specifies compliance with the SPDX Trademark License and provides the exact mandatory copyright notices for verbatim and non-verbatim reproductions or distributions of SPDX Specification 3.0.1.
Section 6 (Model and serializations) heading and subsection number 6.1 introducing the data model and serialization clauses.

Section 6.1 (Overview): States that the SPDX data model is based on the Resource Description Framework (RDF) extensible knowledge representation model and can be serialized in multiple formats for storage and transmission.

Section 6.2 (RDF serialization): Lists supported RDF serialization formats—including JSON-LD 1.1, RDF 1.1 Turtle, N-Triples, and RDF/XML—and notes the accompanying JSON-LD context file for human-readable JSON-LD serialization.

Section 6.3 (Canonical serialization): Defines the deterministic, single-line RFC 8259 JSON canonical form for SPDX JSON-LD data, specifying rules for double-quoted keys, no external whitespace, lowercase literals (`true`, `false`, `null`), base-10 integers without leading zeros, UTF-8 string escaping, arrays, and lexicographically ordered ASCII object keys.

Section 6.4 (Serialization information): Explains how an `SpdxDocument` element represents a logical collection of elements across formats while an `Artifact` linked via `serializedInArtifact` represents the physical bytes, allows native format mechanisms such as `@context` prefixes, and requires at most one `SpdxDocument` per serialization instance.
Section 6.5 (Serialization in JSON-LD) heading and subsection number 6.5.1 introducing the JSON-LD serialization rules.

Section 6.5.1 (JSON-LD context file): Requires all SPDX 3.0.1 JSON-LD documents to reference `"@context": "https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/spdx-context.jsonld"` at the top level, which aliases `@id` as `spdxId` and `@type` as `type` and permits additional namespace mappings.

Section 6.5.2 (JSON-LD validation): Defines the two conformance criteria for SPDX JSON-LD documents—structural validation against the SPDX JSON Schema (`spdx-json-schema.json`) and semantic validation against the SPDX OWL ontology and SHACL shapes (`spdx-model.ttl`).
Section 7 (Additional information) heading and subsection number 7.1 introducing the acknowledgements clause.
Section 7.1 (Author acknowledgements): Lists the contributors who authored the SPDX 3.0 specification.
Section 8 (Core): Introduces the `Core` namespace (`https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core`) as the foundational basis for all SPDX 3.0 profiles.
Section 8.1 (Classes) heading and subsection number 8.1.1 introducing the Core profile class definitions.

Section 8.1.1 (`Agent`): Defines the concrete `/Core/Agent` class (subclass of `/Core/Element`) representing any entity with the potential to act on a system—such as a person, organization, or software agent, distinct from tools—along with its inherited properties (`comment`, `creationInfo`, `description`, `extension`, `externalIdentifier`, `externalRef`, `name`, `spdxId`, `summary`, `verifiedUsing`).

Section 8.1.2 (`Annotation`): Defines the concrete `/Core/Annotation` class (subclass of `/Core/Element`) for assertions made in relation to an element, specifying direct properties `annotationType` (`1..1`), `contentType` (`0..1`), `statement` (`0..1`), and `subject` (`1..1`) plus inherited `Element` properties.

Section 8.1.3 (`Artifact`): Defines the abstract `/Core/Artifact` class (subclass of `/Core/Element`) representing a distinct digital article or unit (file, package, device, or data element), with properties `builtTime`, `originatedBy`, `releaseTime`, `standardName`, `suppliedBy`, `supportLevel`, and `validUntilTime` plus inherited `Element` properties.

Section 8.1.4 (`Bom`): Defines the concrete `/Core/Bom` class as a Bill of Materials container grouping SPDX 3.0 content that characterizes a product's composition, provenance, licensing, and quality or security details.

Continuation of Section 8.1.4 (`Bom`): Lists the superclasses of `/Core/Bom` (`/Core/Bundle`, `/Core/ElementCollection`, and `/Core/Element`) and the beginning of its informative property table (`comment` and `context`).

Completes the informative property table for `/Core/Bom` and defines Section 8.1.5 (`Bundle`), the concrete `/Core/Bundle` class (subclass of `ElementCollection` and `Element`) representing a collection of elements sharing a common `context` (`0..1`), along with its full property table.

Section 8.1.6 (`CreationInfo`): Defines the concrete `/Core/CreationInfo` class recording who created an element and when and how it was created (noting that `created` often reflects the last artifact change date for reproducible builds), with properties `comment` (`0..1`), `created` (`1..1`), `createdBy` (`1..*`), `createdUsing` (`0..*`), and `specVersion` (`1..1`).

Defines Section 8.1.7 (`DictionaryEntry`), a concrete key-value pair class (`key` `1..1`, `value` `0..1`) for string mappings, and begins Section 8.1.8 (`Element`), the abstract base domain class `/Core/Element` from which all SPDX 3.0 domain classes derive.

Completes the direct and informative property tables for Section 8.1.8 (`/Core/Element`), covering `comment`, `creationInfo` (`1..1`), `description`, `extension`, `externalIdentifier`, `externalRef`, `name`, `spdxId` (`1..1`), `summary`, and `verifiedUsing`.

Section 8.1.9 (`ElementCollection`): Defines the abstract `/Core/ElementCollection` class (subclass of `/Core/Element`) for collections of elements defaulting to `core` profile conformance, requiring at least one `rootElement` when `element` is non-empty and forbidding `SpdxDocument` in `element` or `rootElement`.

Completes the informative property table for `/Core/ElementCollection` and defines Section 8.1.10 (`ExternalIdentifier`), the concrete `/Core/ExternalIdentifier` class for referencing an external resource identifier that uniquely identifies an `Element` via `externalIdentifierType` (`1..1`), `identifier` (`1..1`), `identifierLocator` (`0..*`), `issuingAuthority` (`0..1`), and `comment` (`0..1`).

Defines Section 8.1.11 (`ExternalMap`), a concrete `/Core/ExternalMap` class mapping external `Element` identifiers used within an `SpdxDocument` (`definingArtifact` `0..1`, `externalSpdxId` `1..1`, `locationHint` `0..1`, `verifiedUsing` `0..*`), and Section 8.1.12 (`ExternalRef`), a concrete `/Core/ExternalRef` class pointing to external resources related to an `Element` (`comment` `0..1`, `contentType` `0..1`, `externalRefType` `0..1`, `locator` `0..*`).
Begins Section 8.1.13 (`Hash`), defining the concrete `/Core/Hash` class for one-way mathematical hash representations used in data integrity verification.

Completes Section 8.1.13 (`/Core/Hash`, subclass of `/Core/IntegrityMethod`), specifying its direct and inherited properties (`algorithm` `1..1` of type `HashAlgorithm`, `hashValue` `1..1`, and `comment` `0..1`).

Defines Section 8.1.14 (`IndividualElement`), a concrete `/Core/IndividualElement` subclass of `/Core/Element` providing the type for Core profile individuals such as `NoneElement` and `NoAssertionElement`, and Section 8.1.15 (`IntegrityMethod`), the abstract `/Core/IntegrityMethod` base class (`comment` `0..1`) for independently reproducible element verification mechanisms.

Section 8.1.16 (`LifecycleScopedRelationship`): Defines the concrete `/Core/LifecycleScopedRelationship` subclass of `/Core/Relationship` (and `/Core/Element`), adding an optional `scope` (`0..1` of type `LifecycleScopeType`) to parameterize lifecycle-sensitive relationships.

Section 8.1.17 (`NamespaceMap`): Defines the concrete `/Core/NamespaceMap` class (`namespace` `1..1` of type `xsd:anyURI`, `prefix` `1..1` of type `xsd:string`) for mapping short prefixes to namespace partial URIs in SPDX serializations, along with three producer/consumer and round-tripping use cases.

Section 8.1.18 (`Organization`): Defines the concrete `/Core/Organization` subclass of `/Core/Agent` (and `/Core/Element`) representing a group of people working together in an organized way for a shared purpose, along with its inherited `/Core/Element` property table.

Section 8.1.19 (`PackageVerificationCode`): Defines the concrete `/Core/PackageVerificationCode` subclass of `/Core/IntegrityMethod` for SPDX 2.X-compatible package verification (`algorithm` `1..1`, `hashValue` `1..1`, `packageVerificationCodeExcludedFile` `0..*`), including the ASCII-sorted file hash aggregation algorithm and guidance discouraging its use when `Artifact` `contentIdentifier` applies.

Section 8.1.20 (`Person`): Defines the concrete `/Core/Person` subclass of `/Core/Agent` (and `/Core/Element`) representing an individual human being, along with its inherited `/Core/Element` property table.

Section 8.1.21 (`PositiveIntegerRange`): Defines the concrete `/Core/PositiveIntegerRange` class representing an ordered pair of positive integers (`beginIntegerRange` `1..1` and `endIntegerRange` `1..1` of type `xsd:positiveInteger`, where `beginIntegerRange <= endIntegerRange`).

Section 8.1.22 (`Relationship`): Defines the concrete `/Core/Relationship` subclass of `/Core/Element` asserting directed relationships from one `Element` (`from` `1..1`) to one or more `Element`s (`to` `1..*`) with `relationshipType` (`1..1`), optional `completeness` (`0..1`), `startTime` (`0..1`), and `endTime` (`0..1`), and rules for using `NoneElement` and `NoAssertionElement` in `to`.

Section 8.1.23 (`SoftwareAgent`): Defines the concrete `/Core/SoftwareAgent` subclass of `/Core/Agent` (and `/Core/Element`) representing a software program authorized to act on a system, along with its inherited `/Core/Element` property table.

Begins Section 8.1.24 (`SpdxDocument`), defining the concrete `/Core/SpdxDocument` subclass of `/Core/ElementCollection` for collections of SPDX Elements serializable as complete units, and requiring that any serialization instance contain at most one `SpdxDocument` element definition.

Completes Section 8.1.24 (`/Core/SpdxDocument`), listing its direct properties (`dataLicense` `0..1` of type `/SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo`, `import` `0..*` of type `ExternalMap`, `namespaceMap` `0..*` of type `NamespaceMap`) and its full informative property table.
Begins Section 8.1.25 (`Tool`), defining the concrete `/Core/Tool` subclass of `/Core/Element` representing hardware and/or software utilized to carry out a particular function.
Completes the informative property table for Section 8.1.25 (`/Core/Tool`) and opens Section 8.2 (`Properties`), which defines the properties of the Core profile starting with Section 8.2.1.

Section 8.2.1 (`algorithm`): Defines the `/Core/algorithm` object property (range `HashAlgorithm`, referenced by `/Core/Hash` and `/Core/PackageVerificationCode`) specifying the hash calculation algorithm.
Section 8.2.2 (`annotationType`): Defines the `/Core/annotationType` object property (range `AnnotationType`, referenced by `/Core/Annotation`) describing the type of an annotation.

Section 8.2.3 (`beginIntegerRange`): Defines the `/Core/beginIntegerRange` data property (range `xsd:positiveInteger`, referenced by `/Core/PositiveIntegerRange`) specifying the start of an integer range.

Defines Section 8.2.4 (`builtTime`), the `/Core/builtTime` data property (range `DateTime`, referenced by `/Core/Artifact`) specifying when an artifact was built, and Section 8.2.5 (`comment`), the `/Core/comment` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `CreationInfo`, `Element`, `ExternalIdentifier`, `ExternalRef`, and `IntegrityMethod`) for creator comments to readers/reviewers.

Section 8.2.6 (`completeness`): Defines the `/Core/completeness` object property (range `RelationshipCompleteness`, referenced by `/Core/Relationship`) indicating whether a relationship assertion is complete, incomplete, or makes no assertion.

Section 8.2.7 (`contentType`): Defines the `/Core/contentType` data property (range `MediaType`, referenced by `/Core/Annotation`, `/Core/ExternalRef`, and `/Software/File`) estimating the intrinsic media content type of an `Element` or `Property`.

Section 8.2.8 (`context`): Defines the `/Core/context` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/Bundle`) describing the circumstances or unifying properties under which a `Bundle`'s elements were assembled.

Section 8.2.9 (`created`): Defines the `/Core/created` data property (range `DateTime`) identifying when an `Element` was originally created (often the date of last change, such as a git commit date, to support reproducible builds).
Section heading stub `8.2.10` separating the `/Core/created` property definition from `/Core/createdBy`.
Section 8.2.10 (`createdBy`): Defines the `/Core/createdBy` object property (range `Agent`, referenced by `/Core/CreationInfo`) identifying who or what created the `Element`.
Begins Section 8.2.11 (`createdUsing`), stating the summary for the property that identifies the tooling used during `Element` creation.

Completes Section 8.2.11 (`/Core/createdUsing`, object property with range `Tool`, referenced by `/Core/CreationInfo`) and defines Section 8.2.12 (`creationInfo`), the `/Core/creationInfo` object property (range `CreationInfo`, referenced by `/Core/Element`) providing creation metadata for an `Element`.

Section 8.2.13 (`dataLicense`): Defines the `/Core/dataLicense` object property (range `/SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo`, referenced by `/Core/SpdxDocument`) specifying the license for SPDX metadata, including the agreement that copyrightable explanatory text in `SPDX-Metadata` is subject to CC0 1.0 Universal and provided "as-is" without warranty.
Begins Section 8.2.14 (`definingArtifact`) with the `Summary` heading for the external element defining artifact property.

Completes Section 8.2.14 (`/Core/definingArtifact`, object property with range `Artifact`, referenced by `/Core/ExternalMap`), defines Section 8.2.15 (`description`), the `/Core/description` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/Element`) for detailed technical descriptions of an `Element`, and defines Section 8.2.16 (`element`), the `/Core/element` object property (range `Element`, referenced by `/Core/ElementCollection`) referring to member elements of an `ElementCollection`.
Section 8.2.17 (`endIntegerRange`): Defines the `/Core/endIntegerRange` data property (range `xsd:positiveInteger`, referenced by `/Core/PositiveIntegerRange`) specifying the end of an integer range.

Section 8.2.18 (`endTime`): Defines the `/Core/endTime` data property (range `DateTime`, referenced by `/Core/Relationship`) specifying the time from which an element or relationship is no longer applicable or valid.

Section 8.2.19 (`extension`): Defines the `/Core/extension` object property (range `/Extension/Extension`, referenced by `/Core/Element`) specifying an `Extension`-based characterization of an aspect of an `Element`.

Section 8.2.20 (`externalIdentifier`): Defines the `/Core/externalIdentifier` object property (range `ExternalIdentifier`, referenced by `/Core/Element`) referencing an external resource that uniquely identifies an `Element`.

Section 8.2.21 (`externalIdentifierType`): Defines the `/Core/externalIdentifierType` object property (range `ExternalIdentifierType`, referenced by `/Core/ExternalIdentifier`) specifying the type of an external identifier.

Section 8.2.22 (`externalRef`): Defines the `/Core/externalRef` object property (range `ExternalRef`, referenced by `/Core/Element`) pointing to an external resource that provides additional characteristics of an `Element`.
Section 8.2.23 (`externalRefType`): Defines the `/Core/externalRefType` object property (range `ExternalRefType`, referenced by `/Core/ExternalRef`) specifying the type of an external reference.

Section 8.2.24 (`externalSpdxId`): Defines the `/Core/externalSpdxId` data property (range `xsd:anyURI`, referenced by `/Core/ExternalMap`) identifying an `Element` used within an `SpdxDocument` but defined externally.
Section 8.2.25 (`from`): Defines the `/Core/from` object property (range `Element`, referenced by `/Core/Relationship`) referencing the left-hand (source) `Element` of a relationship.

Section 8.2.26 (`hashValue`): Defines the `/Core/hashValue` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/Hash` and `/Core/PackageVerificationCode`) recording the string result of applying a hash algorithm to an `Element`.
Section 8.2.27 (`identifier`): Defines the `/Core/identifier` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/ExternalIdentifier`) uniquely identifying an external element.

Section 8.2.28 (`identifierLocator`): Defines the `/Core/identifierLocator` data property (range `xsd:anyURI`, referenced by `/Core/ExternalIdentifier`) providing a URL location hint for contextual information about an external identifier.

Section 8.2.29 (`import`): Defines the `/Core/import` object property (range `ExternalMap`, referenced by `/Core/SpdxDocument`) providing an `ExternalMap` of externally defined `Element` identifiers used within a document.

Section 8.2.30 (`issuingAuthority`): Defines the `/Core/issuingAuthority` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/ExternalIdentifier`) identifying the entity (government, non-profit, educational institution, or commercial enterprise) authorized to issue identification credentials.
Begins Section 8.2.31 (`key`), giving the summary, description, and URI (`https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/key`) for the key of a generic key-value pair in a dictionary.
Completes the metadata for Section 8.2.31 (`/Core/key`, data property with range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/DictionaryEntry`) and opens Section 8.2.32.

Defines Section 8.2.32 (`locationHint`), the `/Core/locationHint` data property (range `xsd:anyURI`, referenced by `/Core/ExternalMap`) indicating where to retrieve an external `Element`; Section 8.2.33 (`locator`), the `/Core/locator` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/ExternalRef`) giving the location of an external reference; and Section 8.2.34 (`name`), the `/Core/name` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/Element`) for the creator-designated human-readable name of an `Element`.
Begins Section 8.2.35 (`namespace`), defining the `/Core/namespace` data property (range `xsd:anyURI`) for conveying the unambiguous URI namespace portion of an `Element` ID.
Section heading stub `8.2.36` (`namespaceMap`) introducing the `Summary` heading for the `/Core/namespaceMap` property.

Completes Section 8.2.36 (`namespaceMap`), defining the `/Core/namespaceMap` object property (range `NamespaceMap`, referenced by `/Core/SpdxDocument`) that provides a serialization-independent map of prefixes and associated namespace partial URIs applicable to an `SpdxDocument`, and opens Section 8.2.37.

Section 8.2.37 (`originatedBy`): Defines the `/Core/originatedBy` object property (range `Agent`, referenced by `/Core/Artifact`) identifying from where or whom an `Element` originally came, and opens Section 8.2.38.

Defines Section 8.2.38 (`packageVerificationCodeExcludedFile`), the `/Core/packageVerificationCodeExcludedFile` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/PackageVerificationCode`) specifying `./`-prefixed relative filenames excluded from a `PackageVerificationCode`, and Section 8.2.39 (`prefix`), the `/Core/prefix` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/NamespaceMap`) representing a URI substitute.

Section 8.2.40 (`profileConformance`): Defines the `/Core/profileConformance` object property (range `ProfileIdentifierType`, referenced by `/Core/ElementCollection`, default `"core"`) declaring the profile(s) to which the creator of an `ElementCollection` and its contained `Element`s intend to conform.

Section 8.2.41 (`relationshipType`): Defines the `/Core/relationshipType` object property (range `RelationshipType`, referenced by `/Core/Relationship`) describing the type of relationship between two `Element`s (such as between files, packages, or `SpdxDocument`s).
Section 8.2.42 (`releaseTime`): Defines the `/Core/releaseTime` data property (range `DateTime`, referenced by `/Core/Artifact`) specifying the timestamp when an artifact was released.

Section 8.2.43 (`rootElement`): Defines the `/Core/rootElement` object property (range `Element`, referenced by `/Core/ElementCollection`) denoting the root `Element`(s) of a tree of directly and indirectly related elements contained in a BOM.

Section 8.2.44 (`scope`): Defines the `/Core/scope` object property (range `LifecycleScopeType`, referenced by `/Core/LifecycleScopedRelationship`) capturing lifecycle context that clarifies a relationship between elements.

Section 8.2.45 (`spdxId`): Defines the `/Core/spdxId` data property (range `xsd:anyURI`, referenced by `/Core/Element`) uniquely identifying an `Element` for internal or external reference across versions and relationships, and opens Section 8.2.46.

Section 8.2.46 (`specVersion`): Defines the `/Core/specVersion` data property (range `SemVer`, referenced by `/Core/CreationInfo`) providing the semantic version number (major, minor, patch) of the SPDX specification to which an `Element` conforms for parsing and backward compatibility, and opens Section 8.2.47.

Section 8.2.47 (`standardName`): Defines the `/Core/standardName` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/Artifact`) recording the name of a relevant standard applicable to an artifact, and opens Section 8.2.48.

Section 8.2.48 (`startTime`): Defines the `/Core/startTime` data property (range `DateTime`, referenced by `/Core/Relationship`) specifying the timestamp from which an element or relationship is applicable and valid, and opens Section 8.2.49.

Section 8.2.49 (`statement`): Defines the `/Core/statement` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/Annotation`) capturing commentary on an assertion made by an annotator, and opens Section 8.2.50.

Defines Section 8.2.50 (`subject`), the `/Core/subject` object property (range `Element`, referenced by `/Core/Annotation`) identifying the `Element` about which an annotator makes an assertion, and Section 8.2.51 (`summary`), the `/Core/summary` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/Element`) providing a short description of an `Element`'s function or use.

Section 8.2.52 (`suppliedBy`): Defines the `/Core/suppliedBy` object property (range `Agent`, referenced by `/Core/Artifact` and `/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship`) identifying the actual distribution source of an artifact or vulnerability assessment relationship, which may differ from its originating source.

Section 8.2.53 (`supportLevel`): Defines the `/Core/supportLevel` object property (range `SupportType`, referenced by `/Core/Artifact`) indicating the level of support expectations provided by an artifact's supplier, and opens Section 8.2.54.

Section 8.2.54 (`to`): Defines the `/Core/to` object property (range `Element`, referenced by `/Core/Relationship`) referencing the right-hand (target) `Element` of a relationship, where omission indicates no known relationships of that type.

Section 8.2.55 (`validUntilTime`): Defines the `/Core/validUntilTime` data property (range `DateTime`, referenced by `/Core/Artifact`) specifying the timestamp until which an artifact can be used before its usage requires reassessment.

Section 8.2.56 (`value`): Defines the `/Core/value` data property (range `xsd:string`, referenced by `/Core/DictionaryEntry`) storing the value component of a generic key-value pair in a dictionary, and opens Section 8.2.57.

Section 8.2.57 (`verifiedUsing`): Defines the `/Core/verifiedUsing` object property (range `IntegrityMethod`, referenced by `/Core/Element` and `/Core/ExternalMap`) providing an `IntegrityMethod` for asserting the integrity of an `Element`, and opens Section 8.3.
Section heading stub `8.3` (`Vocabularies`) introducing subsection `8.3.1` for the Core profile vocabularies.

Section 8.3.1 (`AnnotationType`): Defines the `/Core/AnnotationType` vocabulary enumerating annotation types: `other` (extra non-review information about an `Element`) and `review` (information from a review of an `Element`).

Section 8.3.2 (`ExternalIdentifierType`): Defines the `/Core/ExternalIdentifierType` vocabulary enumerating external identifier types (`cpe22`, `cpe23`, `cve`, `email`, `gitoid`, `other`, `packageUrl`, `securityOther`, `swhid`, `swid`, and `urlScheme`), including OmniBOR guidance distinguishing artifact `contentIdentifier` gitoids from input manifest `externalIdentifier` gitoids.

Section 8.3.3 (`ExternalRefType`): Defines the `/Core/ExternalRefType` vocabulary enumerating 41 external reference types for packages, artifacts, and security documentation—including package ecosystem locators (`bower`, `mavenCentral`, `npm`, `nuget`), analysis and quality reports, security advisories/fixes/models, and VDR (`vulnerabilityDisclosureReport`) and VEX (`vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment`) references.

Section 8.3.4 (`HashAlgorithm`): Defines the `/Core/HashAlgorithm` vocabulary enumerating one-way cryptographic and checksum hash algorithms (`adler32`, `blake2b256`, `blake2b384`, `blake2b512`, `blake3`, `crystalsDilithium`, `crystalsKyber`, `falcon`, `md2`, `md4`, `md5`, `md6`, `other`, `sha1`, `sha224`, `sha256`, `sha384`, `sha3_224`, `sha3_256`, `sha3_384`, `sha3_512`, and `sha512`).

Section 8.3.5 (`LifecycleScopeType`): Lists RFC/FIPS/NIST footnote URLs for `HashAlgorithm` and defines the `/Core/LifecycleScopeType` vocabulary enumerating lifecycle phases (`build`, `design`, `development`, `other`, `runtime`, and `test`) that contextualize dependency and other relationships.
Section 8.3.6 (`PresenceType`): Defines the `/Core/PresenceType` vocabulary enumerating categories of field presence or absence (`no`, `noAssertion`, and `yes`).

Section 8.3.7 (`ProfileIdentifierType`): Defines the `/Core/ProfileIdentifierType` vocabulary enumerating valid SPDX 3.0 profiles (`ai`, `build`, `core`, `dataset`, `expandedLicensing`, `extension`, `lite`, `security`, `simpleLicensing`, and `software`) for `profileConformance` claims.

Section 8.3.8 (`RelationshipCompleteness`): Defines the `/Core/RelationshipCompleteness` vocabulary indicating whether a relationship is exhaustive (`complete`), known not to be exhaustive (`incomplete`), or unspecified (`noAssertion`).

Section 8.3.9 (`RelationshipType`): Defines the `/Core/RelationshipType` vocabulary enumerating 57 directed (and `other` directionless) relationship types between `from` and `to` `Element`s across lifecycle, dependency, build, licensing, file modification, AI training/testing, and security/VEX assessment contexts.

Section 8.3.10 (`SupportType`): Defines the `/Core/SupportType` vocabulary enumerating supply-chain artifact support levels (`deployed`, `development`, `endOfSupport`, `limitedSupport`, `noAssertion`, `noSupport`, and `support`) and opens Section 8.4.

Section 8.4.2 (`NoneElement`): Defines the `/Core/NoneElement` individual (`IndividualElement`) asserting a set of `Element`s with cardinality zero (no elements exist for the given context of use).

Section 8.4.3 (`SpdxOrganization`): Defines the `/Core/SpdxOrganization` individual (`Organization`, IRI `https://spdx.org/`) representing the SPDX Project as the creator of all specification-defined and SPDX License List individual elements, and opens Section 8.5.

Section 8.5.2 (`MediaType`): Defines the `/Core/MediaType` datatype (subclass of `xsd:string`, pattern `^[^\\/]+\\/[^\\/]+$`) for RFC 2046 MIME media types indicating the content type of an `Element` or property, with examples and IANA registry reference.
